title: Simplify hero copy and layer noise
context: Follow-up feedback requests removal of redundant default-text classes in the redesigned homepage hero while preserving manually refined highlight gradients, plus a tiled nnnoise.svg texture above the responsive SVG artwork.

tasks.title: Simplify hero copy and add the noise texture layer
acceptance_criteria: The default hero copy inherits its Source Serif 4 ExtraBold Italic styling from the heading and uses no heroCopy utility classes
The hand-crafted and AI-accelerated phrases retain their Switzer ExtraBold gradient styling and the current refined gradient stops
The hero layers a repeating nnnoise.svg texture above bg-home-hero-mobile.svg below 48rem and bg-home-hero.svg at 48rem and above without adding a gradient overlay
Browser coverage verifies the simplified copy, responsive artwork/noise layers, typography, and no horizontal overflow
